market.question: Will there be between 35 and 59 tornadoes in the US in October 2026?

frozen_criterion.yes: The first relevant tornado count published on the NCEI U.S. Tornadoes Time Series after scheduled monthly release determines the monthly U.S. tornado count; Yes if the count is 35–59 inclusive. Only the final NCEI dataset for October 2026 counts. Pre-release preliminary values are excluded. If the post-scheduled-release value is labeled preliminary, it controls despite later revisions.
frozen_criterion.fallback: If no data is published by the scheduled release or site is temporarily unavailable, remain open until available; if still unavailable by next scheduled publication, use most recent prior month; permanent NCEI unavailability permits another credible source.

primary_sources.fact: Exact resolution-source page. Captured HTML is an NCEI page shell/SPA; no October 2026 count or final monthly value appears in its static body.

Current official schedule body states “October U.S. Release: Mon, 9 Nov 2026, 11:00 AM EST.” This differs from the frozen rule’s scheduled Nov 11, 2026 11:00 AM ET; I preserve both as a source/criteria discrepancy, not a resolution conclusion.

Official dataset: “State of the Climate Monthly Overview - National Tornadoes”; metadata temporal coverage 2006 to present, with NCEI datasets generally primary for the monthly narrative. Dataset-level context, not the market-specific count.
